airline.text: Before taking any actions that update the booking database, you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.
Flight can be cancelled only when the booking was made within the last 24 hrs, the flight was cancelled by the airline, it is a business flight, or covered travel insurance applies.
The agent must obtain the reason for cancellation.
Basic economy flights cannot be modified.
The user cannot modify the number of passengers.
All payment methods must already be in the user profile for safety reasons.

retail.text: The agent must obtain confirmation before submitting a change to an order.
The payment method must be available in the user's profile.
Only the tools applicable to the order's current state may be used.
